title: Family Eucharist Photoessay
description: A parish photoessay from the Family Eucharist at Our Lady & St. James, Bangor, on Sunday 3 May 2026.

hero.alt: The congregation and altar servers gathered inside Our Lady and St. James, Bangor

headline: Family Eucharist
lead: A photoessay from Our Lady & St. James, Bangor, as the parish gathered in Eastertide for prayer, song, service at the altar, and Holy Communion.
intro: These photographs are of the Family Eucharist.

sections.heading: The Procession Begins
text: The morning opens with the parish community standing together as servers and ministers move through the nave toward the altar.

photos.alt: The entrance procession moving through the nave during the Family Eucharist
photos.caption: The procession moves through the gathered members.

photos.alt: Altar servers and congregation during the opening of Mass
photos.caption: Servers, ministers, and parishioners take their places as Mass begins.

photos.alt: Members of the parish standing in prayer during the Family Eucharist
photos.caption: All standing together in the opening moments.

photos.alt: A view of the congregation and sanctuary during Mass
photos.caption: From nave to sanctuary, the church gathers into prayer.

sections.heading: Listening And Responding
text: The lectern, the servers, and the attentive assembly mark the movement into the Liturgy of the Word.

photos.alt: A reader at the lectern with altar servers nearby
photos.caption: A reading is proclaimed from the lectern.

photos.alt: Altar servers standing near the sanctuary during the Family Eucharist
photos.caption: Altar servers stand ready beside the sanctuary.

photos.alt: The parish congregation during the Liturgy of the Word
photos.caption: The congregation listens as the liturgy unfolds.

photos.alt: A quiet moment near the front of the church during Mass
photos.caption: A quiet pause in the Eastertide celebration.

photos.alt: Children, servers, and parishioners gathered during Family Eucharist
photos.caption: Children and adults share the same act of worship.

sections.heading: A Church Drawn To The Table
text: The focus moves toward the altar: candles, vestments, servers, and the Easter light around the sanctuary.

photos.alt: Altar servers and ministers gathered near the altar
photos.caption: Servers gather near the altar.

photos.alt: The sanctuary and altar during the Family Eucharist
photos.caption: The sanctuary holds the stillness of prayer.

photos.alt: A close view of the altar area during Mass
photos.caption: A close view of service at the altar.

photos.alt: Altar servers standing in white albs during Mass
photos.caption: Servers stand in reverent attention.

photos.alt: A row of altar servers standing beside the sanctuary
photos.caption: The ministry of serving is visible and shared.

photos.alt: The priest and altar servers during the Eucharistic liturgy
photos.caption: The altar becomes the centre of the gathered church.

sections.heading: Families Come Forward
text: Selected families and parishioners with birthdays and notable occasions come forward together.

photos.alt: The Communion procession during Family Eucharist
photos.caption: The Communion procession begins.

photos.alt: Parishioners receiving Communion near the sanctuary
photos.caption: Parishioners come forward to receive Holy Communion.

photos.alt: Families waiting in line during Communion
photos.caption: Families wait together in the Communion line.

photos.alt: A family approaching for Communion during the Family Eucharist
photos.caption: Children and adults approach the altar together.

photos.alt: The priest distributing Communion to parishioners
photos.caption: The sacrament is shared with the gathered parish.

photos.alt: A child and family members near the priest during Communion
photos.caption: A family moment at Communion.

photos.alt: Parishioners receiving Communion beside the sanctuary steps
photos.caption: Prayer continues beside the sanctuary steps.

photos.alt: Children and adults receiving Communion during Family Eucharist
photos.caption: Children are present at the heart of the celebration.

photos.alt: The Communion procession continuing inside the church
photos.caption: The line of Communion continues through the nave.

photos.alt: Parishioners and families in the Communion procession
photos.caption: A parish family gathered in faith.

photos.alt: A communicant receiving during the Family Eucharist
photos.caption: A quiet moment of receiving.

photos.alt: The priest distributing Communion to members of the parish
photos.caption: The Communion procession draws toward its close.

sections.heading: The Whole Church In View
text: The the parish, servers, sanctuary, and the church building together in one view.

photos.alt: The congregation and ministers seen from the front of the church
photos.caption: The church gathered from sanctuary to nave.

photos.alt: A wide view of the parish during the Family Eucharist
photos.caption: A wider glimpse of parish life in motion.

photos.alt: A final wide view of altar servers, priest, and congregation inside the church
photos.caption: The closing image holds the whole celebration together.
